$comment: Golden samples for tools/lib/codec (#497, #498, #499) — the language-neutral spec of the tracker wire format. Every `wire` string is real tracker text (claim/release comments and label names from this repo; grant, decision, hold and release-rung comments from repos that adopt it), scrubbed: hosts as h: tokens, session ids, logins, people and branch names replaced; repos as OWNER/REPO; a sample carrying a `note` says what is synthetic about it. For each sample, decode(wire) must deep-equal `decoded` and encode(decoded) must equal `wire` byte for byte. An older reader parses what a newer writer emits, so a change that breaks a sample breaks every machine still running the older reader. `notHolds` are real lines in a looser shape that must decode to null.

labels.note: synthetic edge case: an unknown delivery type still decodes under its prefix (known: false), so a newer vocabulary round-trips through an older reader
synthetic edge case: not a calendar date, so not a review-by label — kept verbatim as other
synthetic edge case: a bare prefix carries no key — kept verbatim as other
